column3: “Put on heart” is rendered “take it to heart”; NASB adds “indeed” and “already.”
“Rebuke” follows the Hebrew; “dung” is rendered “refuse,” and “someone will carry you away” “you will be taken away.”
“To be my covenant” is rendered “that My covenant may continue.”
“Well-being” is rendered “peace”; NASB supplies “one of” and renders “fear” as “an object of reverence.”
“Instruction of truth” is rendered “True instruction”; “turned away” is rendered “turned … back.”
“Lowly” is rendered “abased”; “lifting up faces” is rendered “showing partiality.”
“A god of foreignness” is rendered “a foreign god.”
“A protector and one who answers” is rendered “everyone who awakes and answers”; the meaning is uncertain.
“Another thing” renders “this second thing”; “from not still turning to the offering” is rendered “because He no longer regards the offering.”
“Concerning what?” is rendered “For what reason?,” and “testified” “been a witness.”

NASB renders the difficult opening “not one he made, and a remnant of spirit to him” as “not one has done so who has a remnant of the Spirit”; the meaning is uncertain. “Offspring of God” is rendered “a godly offspring.”
NASB renders “he hates sending away” as “I hate divorce,” changing the person; “violence” is rendered “wrong.”
